known_issues: Welcome pop-up goal list is not scrollable for new users after login; users cannot scroll/select goals beyond the first visible item.

existing_features.title: Fix the Welcome Goal Library popup (GoalLibraryModal) so the goal template list is actually scrollable when the modal opens, allowing a newly logged-in user to scroll through and select goals beyond the initially visible items.

projectName: Make Welcome Goal Library modal goal list scrollable for new users
